summary: Both seasons are a straight, zero-filler Mashima adaptation at a steady ~3 chapters per episode: S1 (eps 1-25) covers chs 1-68 (vols 1-8, Intro through Sun Jewel), S2 (eps 26-50) covers chs 69-140 (vols 9-16, Belial Gore through the start of Nero 66), and the existing ep50->140/v16 anchor is confirmed by Wikipedia, animefillerguide and WDTALO. The edenszero.fandom.com wiki maps every episode at page level (ep infobox 'adapted', mirrored by each chapter's 'relepisode'), and every one of the 50 episode titles equals a Wikipedia chapter title inside the claimed range; 21 anchors are pinned to the exact END by an independent title/endpoint witness (high), the other 29 are the same wiki data bracketed but not pinned (medium). Structure is linear with 20 mid-chapter episode ends (continue points recorded) and a few small page-level reorders: ch 3 (eps 2-3), ch 48 (eps 18-19), ch 80 (eps 29-30), ch 106 (eps 38-39), plus Xiaomei's ch 31 p.1-3 narrator interlude grafted into ep 12. The only real omission is at the finale: ep 50 skips ch 139 p.2-18 (Eraser's fleet battle) and adds anime-original battle beats, yet the public continue point remains ch 141. No type corrections or repairs; no order-only entries (the 2023 S1 recap film has no AniList entry).

structure.notes: Components confirmed: AniList 119683 (TV, 25 eps, 2021-04-11..10-03) -> our eps 1-25; AniList 144932 'EDENS ZERO 2nd Season' (TV, 25 eps, 2023-04-02..10-01) -> our eps 26-50 (AniList relations: 144932 is the SEQUEL of 119683; both ADAPTATION of manga 101860). Our cumulative numbering equals Wikipedia's overall numbering and the fandom wiki's (fandom 'Episode 26' = S2E1); MAL numbers S2 per-season (S2 ep N = our 25+N) — no other conversions were needed. S1 = chs 1-68 / vols 1-8 (Wikipedia S1, animefillerguide); S2 = chs 69-140 / vols 9-16 (Wikipedia S2, animefillerguide, WDTALO); zero filler (animefillerlist: all 50 'Manga Canon'). Arc ranges (fandom chapter infoboxes): Intro 1-3 (eps 1-3), Norma 4-11 (3-6), Skull Fairy 12-14 (6-7), Guilst 15-28 (7-12), Digitalis 29-43 (12-17), Mildian 44-48 (17-19), Sun Jewel 49-68 (19-25), Belial Gore 69-99 (26-36), Edens One 100-104 (36-38), Red Cave 105-111 (38-40), Foresta 112-133 (41-48), Sandra 134-138 (48-50), Nero 66 139+ (50). Series-level suggestion: manga_start_chapter 1, max_adapted_chapter 140, continue_from_chapter 141. A 72-minute 'Edens Zero Season 1 Recap Movie' aired in Japan 2023-04-01 (Crunchyroll 2023-04-29; AniDB lists it as S1 special ep 266091) but has no AniList entry (AniList search for 'Soushuuhen'/'Recap' returns nothing and neither season lists a relation), so no order-only component is needed; it adapts nothing new and would sit between 119683 and 144932 if it ever appears.

flags_for_sean: Single-lineage caveat: every page-level split and 47 of the 50 exact END chapters rest on edenszero.fandom.com (episode-page 'adapted' field, cross-checked against the separately maintained chapter-page 'relepisode' field for chs 1-141: they agree at chapter level everywhere, with 1-3 page pagination differences at chs 39/45/48/51/101/134). Independent evidence is bracket-level: all 50 episode titles equal Wikipedia chapter titles inside the claimed ranges, Wikipedia pins the season endpoints (1-68, 69-140), a MAL finale comment pins 'continue at ch 69', and AFG/WDTALO pin 141. Reddit (403), pixiv/Niconico dictionaries (403), TV Tropes (403) and Jikan (504) were unreachable, the 7 MAL episode threads sampled carry no chapter mentions, and the session's WebSearch budget ran out mid-task, so no third-party per-episode table was found. Anchors marked 'high' have a title match or season endpoint touching the exact END value; 'medium' ones are the same wiki data with only a bracket check — recommend applying them (zero-filler, monotone ~3-chapter cadence).

ep 18/19 title anomaly: ep 19 is titled after ch 48 ('From the Planet of Eternity') but the wiki places the bulk of ch 48 in ep 18 (p.2-16 and p.20) with only p.17-19 in ep 19. Chapter-level anchors are unaffected (ep 18 END 48, ep 19 START 49); flagging in case the position instrument should treat ch 48 as ep 19's.
ep 50 (existing anchor, out of range but verified): ch 139 p.2-18 is never adapted; all public sources still say resume at ch 141. A completionist reader should read ch 139 in full.
